review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Deregister the per-open Cloud SQL dial callback**

On each Cloud SQL MySQL open this adds a fresh callback to go-sql-driver's process-global registry, but neither `Driver.Close` nor the `sql.Open` error path calls `mysql.DeregisterDialContext`; the identical path in `backend/plugin/db/oceanbase/oceanbase.go:347-351` has the same problem. Because DBFactory constructs transient drivers for queries and schema syncs, the registry callback retains the closed dialer and its config after every close, so a long-running server serving these engines grows memory without bound (the existing cleanup in `backend/component/ghost/config.go:449-453` demonstrates the required deregistration); retain the network/cleanup on the driver and invoke it on both exit paths.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
